speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a skin lesion on your chest; how long has it been there and has it changed in size, color, or shape recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 63-year-old male. The patient reports noticing a skin lesion on his chest 2 months ago, which he believes has increased in size. He denies any associated pain or itching with the lesion. He has a medical history significant for type 2 diabetes mellitus, hypercholesterolemia, and glaucoma.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details, Mr. 63. Given your history of diabetes and the lesion's recent growth, have you noticed any ulceration, bleeding, or irregular borders? Also, is the surrounding skin warmer or more tender to the touch?

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count, Hemoglobin A1c

speaker: Doctor
text:
The blood work is normal. Have you noticed any pain, tenderness, or drainage from the lesion? Also, does the lesion have an "ugly duckling" appearance compared to other moles on your body?
